rationale: THE CLOSEST C++ CONSTRUCT TO `renders`, MEASURED. The canonical contract (src/ast/types.ts, Renders) is 'a component RENDERS another component: source = the rendering symbol, target = the rendered component', measured on TSX/JSX. C++ has no component/markup construct: what exists is ordinary calls whose NAMES are render verbs — `panel.addWidget(button)`, `panel.paint()`, `draw(panel, button)`. Each is emitted as `calls`, which is what the source says; a `renders` edge would assert a component-production relation the language never declares. RULED on LANGUAGE semantics: the construct is a call, not a rendering. This fixture PINS that mapping.
